itemdesc-armor-body-easterling-lokegamp: Quite literally the bite of the Emperor's army, the Loke-Gamp Rim are highly trained pikemen and swordsmen of the Loke-Rim
itemdesc-armor-body-easterling-lokeflag: Heavily armoured and armed, the Loke-Flag Rim are capable shock troops, usually wielding heavy steel maces or axes and protect themselves with large shields.
itemdesc-armor-body-easterling-lokenar: The Loke-Nar Rim are some of the finest scouts in Middle-earth. They usually utilize large composite longbows with incredible range and power.
itemdesc-armor-head-easterling-lokegamp: Their job in battle is to close with the enemy under the protection of the Dragon's Fire and pin them in position, making the enemy susceptible to envelopment and destruction.
itemdesc-armor-head-easterling-lokeflag: Primarily, their role is to protect the flanks of the Dragons Teeth, but they can also be used to soften the enemy up prior to main battle line engaging in melee.
itemdesc-easterling-schematic: A scroll with the smell of salt and smoke, full of knowledge passed down from generations of the Dragon Cult of the Sea of Rhun.
itemdesc-easterling-rolled-schematic: A scroll with the smell of salt and smoke, full of knowledge passed down from generations of the Dragon Cult of the Sea of Rhun
